sequence.basis: Existing native command events and actual RED/GREEN, final test, Clippy, build and completed measurement outputs inspected; no new test, measurement, history archive or analyzer
Changed production and benchmark reviewed after procedural PASS; reviewer authored none of this iteration's production changes, benchmark or new tests

reviewed_invariants: Packed left/right neighbors wrap at the actual valid ring width. Width one, width two, full words and partial final words preserve MSB-first semantics; final padding is masked after every step and serialized canonically.
Scratch storage is overwritten for every word before each swap. Packed rows are created only from fully decoded/validated state, cannot change width, and are not exposed to callers.
Scalar State::step retains its behavior. Numeric transitions and header emission share unchanged floating-point operation order; stale scalar seed rings are never emitted by packed replay.
Exact output-size preflight, step/work/object limits and final produced-length check remain in force. Packed replay reserves the exact output once and adds only bounded word/scratch storage.
PreparedPrediction owns private immutable boxed checkpoint, prediction and setup buffers. Mutating caller inputs after construction cannot alter retained state; callers receive only read-only slices.

Prepared construction validates/replays/hashes once, and target preparation applies the existing bounded exact residual encoder. The original and prepared APIs share identical byte-first selection, offering and acknowledgement paths.

Prepared state conveys no authority. Receiver namespace, epoch, admission, replay validation, final digest and durable publication checks are unchanged. No receiver replay cache or global unbounded prediction cache is introduced.
Retained-byte accounting explicitly excludes allocator metadata, temporary buffers and total process memory; multiple retained predictions require a caller-wide budget.
The benchmark transfers all arms through the real endpoint and batch codec, reopens every seed and target, counts both body directions plus reply timing fields, and verifies selected-body costs.

A fixed seeded shuffle varies arm order. Baseline and candidate use identical benchmark source, and the candidate-only cfg selects its new prepared API. Failed workers retain output/cache and stop the driver without retry or outlier removal.
CPU/wall totals include receiver work once; exchange and receiver timers are nested. Preparation, standalone fixture replay and post-commit exact verification are separate measured scopes.

The same prepared object is actually reused for three targets. Per-use amortization adds preparation once and divides the three-target sum by three. Practical cold totals include required seed and preparation while raw/zstd exclude unnecessary experimental seeds.

observed_qualification.retained_failure: Initial combined parent command passed tests then failed benchmark drop_non_drop Clippy. cfg-only drop correction was followed by three example tests, all-target Clippy and both final benchmark builds.

observed_measurement.paired_runtime_body_costs: unchanged for baseline, packed and prepared arms
observed_measurement.scope: Local serialized durable endpoint mechanism; not a new WAN experiment

limits: Large favorable runtime CPU improves substantially versus the prior runtime but remains above raw, zstd and conventional adaptive CPU; small and unrelated results and unfavorable tails remain in the data.
Prepared send timings exclude initial construction unless an explicitly labeled cold or amortized total includes it.
HTTP-body-equivalent counts are not actual network/full-wire bytes. Exchange time is not pure transmission time.
Retained buffer bytes are not RSS or peak-memory measurements; no energy claim is supported.
Ten paired trials and a separate baseline profile are bounded local evidence. This review does not extend them to WAN, other hardware, MVM or compliance qualification.
The existing benchmark summary is reviewed and its raw census inspected; no new independently implemented statistical analyzer was commissioned for this iteration.
file_claims: Parent confirmed all three completed implementation/measurement claims released before final verdict
next_step: Publish after the parent's normal final source/base check; no additional review campaign requested
